title: Zesty Kenyan Chicken Papillote
description: A light and flavorful Kenyan dish featuring sun-dried tomatoes and chicken cooked in a papillote, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is free from onions and garlic, making it suitable for those with sensitivities.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes, parsley, and basil to the bowl and stir to combine.
Place a chicken breast in the center of a piece of parchment paper.
Spoon the tomato and herb mixture over the chicken breast.
Fold the parchment paper over the chicken to form a papillote, making sure to seal the edges.
Repeat with the remaining chicken breasts and tomato mixture.
Place the papillotes on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the papillotes from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
